at random: The teacher picked students at random to answer questions in class.
老师在课堂上随机点学生回答问题。
a calculated crime: The police believed the theft was a calculated crime, planned months in advance.
警方认为这起盗窃是一起有预谋的犯罪，早在几个月前就策划好了。
roll film: Before digital cameras, photographers had to load roll film carefully in the dark.
在数码相机出现之前，摄影师必须在暗处小心地装胶卷。
igneous: Granite is an igneous rock that forms when hot magma cools slowly underground.
花岗岩是一种火成岩，由炽热岩浆在地下缓慢冷却形成。
rotational: The Earth's rotational speed slowly decreases, making each year slightly longer.
地球自转的速度在慢慢减慢，使每一年略微变长。
gin: He ordered a glass of gin with ice and a slice of lemon.
他点了一杯加冰和柠檬片的杜松子酒。
engaging: The professor's engaging lecture kept every student listening until the very end.
教授那场引人入胜的讲座让每个学生都听到最后。
nosy: My nosy neighbor always asks personal questions about who visits our house.
我那个爱管闲事的邻居总是打听谁来我家做客。
chronical: He suffers from a chronical back problem that makes long flights painful.
他患有慢性背疾，长时间乘飞机会很痛苦。
foliage: In autumn, the bright foliage along the river attracts many tourists.
秋天，河边鲜艳的树叶吸引了许多游客。
genial: Our genial host greeted every guest with a warm smile at the door.
我们和蔼的主人在门口用温暖的微笑迎接每一位客人。
afoul: The new company policy ran afoul of local environmental laws last year.
新公司政策去年与当地的环境法规相抵触。
legislature: The state legislature passed a new law to protect public parks.
州立法机关通过了一部保护公园的新法律。
outgas: New furniture can outgas harmful chemicals for weeks after you buy it.
新家具在买回来后的几周内会释放出有害化学气体。
hypothesize: Scientists hypothesize that this valley was once covered by a huge lake.
科学家们假设这个山谷曾经被一个巨大的湖泊覆盖。
inanity: He was tired of the inanity of the talk shows on television.
他厌倦了电视上脱口秀节目的空洞无聊。
acidity: The acidity of the soil makes it difficult to grow most vegetables.
土壤的酸度使大多数蔬菜难以生长。
indifference: Her indifference to the suffering of others surprised everyone in the office.
她对他人苦难的冷漠让办公室里的每个人都感到惊讶。
fumigate: The hotel had to fumigate all the rooms to get rid of bedbugs.
这家酒店不得不对所有房间进行烟熏消毒，以清除臭虫。
piracy: Software piracy costs companies billions of dollars every year around the world.
软件盗版每年给世界各地的公司造成数十亿美元的损失。
mason: A skilled mason built the stone wall around our garden last summer.
去年夏天，一位技术娴熟的石匠在我们花园四周砌了石墙。
swampy: The path through the swampy ground was wet and difficult to walk on.
穿过湿软沼泽地的小路很泥泞，难以行走。
franchise: She bought a fast-food franchise and opened her first restaurant downtown.
她买下了一家快餐特许经营权，在市中心开了自己的第一家餐厅。
replica: The museum displays a full-size replica of the famous ancient ship.
博物馆展出了那艘著名古船的全尺寸复制品。
infirm: The charity provides meals for elderly and infirm people in the city.
该慈善机构为城里年老体弱的人提供餐食。
Mesolithic: Archaeologists found stone tools from the Mesolithic period near the ancient lake.
考古学家在古湖附近发现了中石器时代的石器。
oblong: She cut the cake into small oblong pieces so everyone got a share.
她把蛋糕切成小块的长方形，这样每个人都能分到一份。
convex: A convex lens makes objects look larger when you look through it.
透过凸透镜看物体时，物体会显得更大。
rationality: In an emergency, fear often wins over rationality and careful thinking.
在紧急情况下，恐惧往往胜过理性和冷静的思考。
quotient: In math class, we learned that the quotient of ten divided by two is five.
在数学课上，我们学到十除以二的商是五。
sapphire: She wore a beautiful ring with a deep blue sapphire in the center.
她戴着一枚漂亮的戒指，中央镶着一颗深蓝色的蓝宝石。
sewerage: The old town finally built a modern sewerage system to keep the river clean.
这座古镇终于建成了现代化的污水排放系统，以保持河水清洁。
dateline: Every news article begins with a dateline telling readers where and when it was written.
每篇新闻报道开头都有日期栏，告诉读者报道的地点和时间。
dynamical: The engineers studied the dynamical behavior of the bridge in strong winds.
工程师们研究了大桥在强风中的动态表现。
grading: The teacher spent the whole weekend grading our English compositions.
老师花了整个周末给我们批改英语作文。
accounting: My sister studies accounting at college because she is good with numbers.
我妹妹在大学学会计，因为她擅长和数字打交道。
canopy: We rested under the thick canopy of trees to escape the hot sun.
我们在茂密的树荫下休息，躲避炎热的阳光。
interstellar: The film tells a story about interstellar travel between distant stars.
这部电影讲述了一个在遥远星球之间进行星际旅行的故事。
injurious: Smoking is injurious to health and damages the lungs over many years.
吸烟有害健康，长年累月会损害肺部。
commune: In the evenings, she would commune with nature during her long quiet walks.
傍晚时分，她会在静谧的长途散步中与大自然亲近交流。
